page.layout: One column of verse, set in the centre of the page under a running head at the top. No marginal notes or page number are printed.

main_text.l: Et quam plus oculis meis amabam.
Casta nec mage castitas vel ipsa.
Nec tantum periit tua hac venustas,
Et lepos soror, omnis ille tecum,
Quæ te, te, soror, abstulere fata,
Ite ergo procul, ite nunc, Camenæ,
Et quei s cuncta cadunt secundiora,

page.notes: The line "Et quei s cuncta cadunt secundiora" is doubtful; the word after "quei" is not clear. "Regnat tristitiæ & doloris usquam" is read as printed, with "usquam" uncertain. A small mark at the bottom right ("v*") is not clear enough to transcribe. Ornaments at the top right edge are not text and are left out.
